title: Normal - No Call
shortDescription: Single flash indicates board OK, no thermostat call.
fullDescription: Keeprite (ICP-family) furnaces use LED flash codes. 1 flash with no call is healthy idle state.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Pressure Switch Stuck Closed
shortDescription: Pressure switch closed before inducer started.
fullDescription: Switch contacts welded or wrong wiring causes board to abort start sequence.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: Pressure switch is keyed; match part number.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Pressure Switch Stuck Open
shortDescription: Pressure switch did not close after inducer ran.
fullDescription: Inducer running but vacuum not pulling switch closed - blocked vent, weak motor, or kinked tubing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect vent termination
fixSteps.instruction: Outside vent cap for snow, leaves, nests.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Limit Switch Open
fullDescription: Heat exchanger overheated - low airflow from dirty filter, blower, or closed vents.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter
fixSteps.instruction: Use correct MERV rating; never run without filter.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Flame Sensed With No Call
shortDescription: Board sees flame current when it shouldn't.
fullDescription: Indicates leaking gas valve or shorted flame sensor wire. Safety lockout.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
safetyWarning: Possible gas leak. If you smell gas, evacuate and call gas company.

title: Igniter Failure
shortDescription: Hot-surface igniter open or out of spec.
fullDescription: Board checked igniter resistance and got open circuit. No ignition trial begins.

fixSteps.title: Replace HSI
fixSteps.instruction: Match part - silicon nitride preferred. Don't touch element.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Flame Not Sensed
shortDescription: Ignition trial - flame failed to prove.
fullDescription: Igniter glowed, gas valve opened, but flame sense rod did not detect microamps.

fixSteps.title: Clean flame sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Fine emery cloth, do not use sandpaper that leaves grit.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Reversed Polarity / Ground Fault
shortDescription: Line voltage hot/neutral reversed or no ground.
fullDescription: Flame sense relies on burner-to-ground path. Reversed polarity prevents flame proving.
symptoms: No heat after install or work nearby
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
safetyWarning: Polarity issues are electrical-code violations. Have an electrician fix.

title: Twinning Fault
shortDescription: Two furnaces twinned together not communicating.
fullDescription: When two furnaces are tied for one duct, twinning kit synchronizes blowers. 9 flash means twinning wiring lost.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Internal Control Failure
shortDescription: LED on solid or rapid continuous - board self-test failed.
fullDescription: Indicates control board has internal fault and needs replacement.

fixSteps.title: Replace board
fixSteps.instruction: Match model number exactly; pro install.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
